label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: Tall loaded shelving, repeated ceiling lights, roof ribs and a gridded skylight clearly reconstruct the warehouse identity.
The main rack recedes along the left beneath the roof, with vertically stacked loads and lights extending along the aisle. Major spatial relationships remain recognizable.
Loads fit the repeated shelf bays, and tall racks, overhead lighting and skylight have plausible relative sizes.
Beige loads, ochre pallets, gray framing and a darker warm roof remain distinguishable. Simplification reduces surface character but preserves broad color correspondence.
Bright overhead strips and skylight establish compatible warm industrial lighting. Heavy noise reduces clarity, but the authored scene remains legible.
Complementary views reveal box depth, shelf undersides, posts and separated rows, supporting genuine spatial geometry. The obstructed detail view does not negate those views.

Rack upright Box.067, pallet Box.113 and load Box.117 are separately addressable MESH objects with finite nonempty geometry, parent chains and assigned materials. Their materials contain connected shader/output nodes.

dimension_scores.evidence: The warehouse and upward aisle composition correspond, but repetitive block loads and simplified shelving lose substantial reference specificity.
Posts and braces form a plausible framework, but pallet support across the sparse cross members is not convincingly resolved; connection details are minimal.
Warm neutral colors and contrasting loads, pallets and structure correspond broadly. Framing is noticeably paler and package surfaces more uniform.
Severe render grain, sharp primitive boxes and sparse package and connection details substantially weaken credibility.
Repeated shelving levels and receding ceiling fixtures preserve the main arrangement, although the authored framing gives the ceiling greater prominence.
Shelf clearances, load sizes and high roof are broadly coherent; simplified rack members and unusually uniform loads reduce accuracy.
Overhead lighting produces readable warm illumination and shadow, but heavy noise and weak material differentiation obscure surface quality.
Major racks, numerous loads, pallets, roof structure, lights and skylight are present. Distinctive yellow rack fittings and varied wrapped-package detail are largely omitted.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
